input.fold: loo_all (forecast made with this wound held out)

stall.truth_definition: stall = the wound closes less than 10% more after the cut-off (area at the last frame >= 90% of the area at the cut-off)

schedule.call: unlikely to reach 90% closure by 19 h
schedule.evidence: on held-out WHAD wounds such early calls were right 91% of the time (always saying no: 75%)

output.start: forecast.band_start(0.25, seed): a synthetic band, not this wound's own mask
output.fit_error_definition: RMSE of area_norm (simulated mean of 3 seeds vs observed) at the observed frames after 0 h up to the check; lower is a better fit

hypotheses.name: partial_stall
hypotheses.description: cells in the lower half of the field never start a move

hypotheses.name: normal
hypotheses.description: default start and preset migration time

hypotheses.name: edge_damage
hypotheses.description: ragged, wider start wound (cells within 2 sites of the edge lost with probability 0.6)

hypotheses.name: low_density
hypotheses.description: 25% of sheet cells missing at the start (weakly identifiable: holes refill)

headline: The run stopped early at 1.9 h after a stall flag, and a human approved the stop.
summary: A stall flag fired at 1.9 h. The tool then ran a forced check, which asked a human to review the stall, and the human approved. The run ended at 1.9 h out of a 19.0 h horizon, which saved 17.1 plate hours. The investigator ranked three hypotheses at the check: slow_migration came first (fit error 0.0104), partial_stall second (0.0151) and normal third (0.0312). These are hypotheses, not confirmed causes.
next_step: Look at the wound images from around 1.9 h to see whether the cells were migrating slowly or had really stalled, and repeat the assay if the reason is still unclear.
caveats: Research use only, not for diagnosis or treatment.
Simulated cells and simulator bands are labelled as simulation, not observation.
Investigator results are hypotheses, not causes.
The fit errors of the top two hypotheses (0.0104 and 0.0151) are close.
The run stopped very early, at 1.9 h of a 19.0 h horizon, so little data was collected.
